meizzwang The night time/true color idea is true. The sun is way too blinding. So much so that it inhibits vision! Ever notice how you can see farther at night than in the day?

Don't think it's true? Count the stars during the day, then at night. You see more at night! The sun is so bright it blocks your perception of everything. In other words, night time photos are cool.
